integrity: Proof is independent of finite computation; executable tests corroborate selected small cases only. No independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only simple undirected finite nonempty disjoint unions of isomorphic K_{a,b} with a,b>=2; ordinary counting-free FO^k with equality and adjacency; unrestricted quantifier depth. No claims for mixed biclique shapes, singleton sides, or counting logic. Historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp \(k\)-variable spectra of disjoint homogeneous bicliques
